recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴球比小淋巴球大，外形被周圍紅血球擠壓成水滴狀，細胞質中等量且邊緣呈較深的藍色（peripheral basophilia），核染色質較開放並隱約可見核仁，符合反應性淋巴球（reactive lymphocyte）。
features: Enlarged lymphocyte, about twice the diameter of adjacent red cells in its long axis
Oval nucleus with moderately condensed but more open chromatin than a resting lymphocyte; one or two small nucleolus-like dark spots
Moderate cytoplasm with deeper blue basophilia accentuated at the periphery
Cell outline molded by and indented around neighboring red cells
No cytoplasmic granules or vacuoles; background red cells with occasional crenated form
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an enlarged lymphocyte with an oval nucleus, moderately condensed to partly open chromatin and small nucleolus-like chromocenters. The cytoplasm is moderate in amount with basophilia accentuated at the cell margin, and the cell contour is molded by adjacent red cells. No cytoplasmic granules are seen. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphocyte, as seen in viral infections such as infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic lymphocytes form a monotonous population with nuclear irregularities such as clefts or convolutions, whereas reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous and show peripheral cytoplasmic basophilia hugging red cells.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles rather than a sharply basophilic rim.
Blasts have very fine uniform chromatin, distinct nucleoli, a high N:C ratio and do not show peripheral basophilia molding around red cells.
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes have an eccentric nucleus with clumped chromatin and uniformly deep blue cytoplasm, sometimes with a hof.
